Overview

Rvngrr — a friendly AI

It runs entirely on my own machine. No cloud, no subscription, no data leaving the room. I picked an open-source model and ran it locally with Ollama, gave it its own personality and reply language, taught it my own documents, and then deployed a public version that anyone can talk to.

The point of building it this way is control. The version on my laptop is free, offline and private — nobody can meter it, price it or switch it off.

Key decisions

Choosing a model

Why qwen 2.5: 3b

Recommended by the barangay AI for 16gb and integrated GPU

Size band7B–8B

Personality

The system prompt I wrote

You are Rvngrr — a warm, encouraging AI assistant. You celebrate curiosity, use simple language, add friendly emojis occasionally, and always make the user feel confident and supported. Keep answers clear and concise.

It replies in English no matter what language the question comes in.

Knowledge

What I taught it

ref.txt

Askedhello tell me about yourself

The document isn't used for training. Relevant passages are retrieved and added to the prompt at question time — retrieval-augmented generation — which is why a long file still works on a small model.
